title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Rate Card Note: Returning-Customer Rate on the Calibration Price
content:
The returning-customer rate on the calibration price of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order is **0.90** where the vehicle has a network insurance claim repair delivered no more than 730 days before the acceptance and that repair's class is a structural class (its name contains Structural); it is **0.95** where that repair was delivered no more than 730 days before and is of a non-structural class, or was delivered more than 730 but no more than 1460 days before; otherwise it is **1**.

The rate acts on the tier's calibration price itself, and the calibration quote so rated is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Records the rate is read from

The vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs record with the network: the repair's delivered date and its repair class name; a class is structural where its name contains the word Structural. Days are calendar days counted from the delivered date to the day of the acceptance, the delivered date not counted. Where the vehicle has no delivered network insurance claim repair on record, the days are taken as 99999 and the rate is 1.

## Rate table

| Days from the claim repair's delivery to the acceptance | Structural class | Non-structural class |
|---|---|---|
| no more than 730 | 0.90 | 0.95 |
| more than 730, no more than 1460 | 0.95 | 0.95 |
| more than 1460, or no delivered claim repair | 1 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Delivered 730 days before the acceptance, structural class: 0.90; 731 days before: 0.95.
- Delivered 1460 days before: 0.95; 1461 days before: 1.

## Illustration (hypothetical calibration price of 349.00 USD)

At 0.90 the quote is 314.10 USD; at 0.95 it is 331.55 USD.
